correctness.rationale: A connected weighted Dirichlet problem has a unique voltage h in [0,1] with terminal values 0 and 1. For every f, Hf=f_a+(f_b-f_a)h, so G(Hf)=|f_b-f_a|G(h). The triangle inequalities over pairs involving a or b give G(f)>=(n-1)|f_b-f_a|, sharply attained when all interior inputs coincide between their two boundary values. Summing h boundary-interior pairs yields G(h)=n-1+sum_{interior unordered pairs}|h_i-h_j|. The sorted interior gap sum has coefficients j(m-j), whose maximum floor(m²/4) proves sharp universal envelope floor(n²/4)/(n-1), including m<=1. Equal interior voltage is equivalent to all equations theta*c_{ia}=(1-theta)*c_{ib}; connectedness suffices even if the interior subgraph is disconnected. The n-node endpoint path has h_j=j/(n-1), giving n(n+1)/(6(n-1)). An independent exact-rational path check n=2..8 corroborates that specialization. The actual Git RESULT.md and source checker were inspected; finite tests do not establish generality.
